name: Medical Physics PhD
detailsNote: Official available requirements. Current Fall 2027 application deadline established. Funding amounts have no stated academic year unless noted; confirm offer. Admission model omitted unless directly established.

english.toefl: 79 with W21/R19 before January 21, 2026; 4.5 total/W/R on or after
english.note: IELTS reading/writing 6.5; Fall 2027 DET total/reading/writing 120. Scores within two years of start. Twin Cities does not accept TOEFL MyBest; IELTS One Skill Retake is not accepted. Education exemption: secondary school in US/listed country, or 16 semester/24 quarter non-ESL postsecondary credits completed within past two years while living in US/listed country. Program may require higher scores.

applicationFee.note: US citizen/PR $75, international $95; nonrefundable. Central office does not waive fees. GSDO conditional route: US citizen/PR seeking first graduate degree with qualifying listed participation; request before submission/payment. Medical School may offer limited domestic waivers; confirm program procedure.

requirements.note: Comparable bachelor, PhD GPA 3.2 (lower considered with documentation). Physics degree or equivalent minor: two semesters calculus-based physics plus three upper-level physics courses. Mathematics through multivariable calculus or differential equations. General GRE required, no subject exam specified. Research statement and CV not required. No conditional admission.

funding.note: Partial RA support may be available depending on funds, placement and availability; typical 10 hours/week at minimum $28.93/hour, possible tuition benefits. Additional faculty-grant PhD support possible. Program itself offers no fee waiver, but points to limited Medical School routes.
